title: He Cried Until His Eyes Turned White, and He Never Gave Up

meta.name: v5_y12_13_grief-and-hope
meta.title: He Cried Until His Eyes Turned White, and He Never Gave Up

lines.text: He cried until his eyes went white, but he never gave up.
Years pass, and Yaʿqūb still grieves.
His sons tell him to stop. He answers:
I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.

quran.ar: إِنَّمَاۤ أَشۡكُوا۟ بَثِّی وَحُزۡنِیۤ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعۡلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ

lines.text: and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people.

quran.ar: وَلَا تَا۟یۡـَٔسُوا۟ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا یَا۟یۡـَٔسُ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡكَـٰفِرُونَ

lines.text: He cried. He did not hide it.
He took his grief to Allāh.
Grief and hope can live together.
